fields.name: ASVTRAVL
fields.description: ADDRESS OF FIRST AVAILABLE REUSABLE ASID SLOT

fields.name: ASVTAAV
fields.description: NUMBER OF FREE SLOTS ON THE ASVT AVAILABLE QUEUE.

fields.name: ASVTAST
fields.description: NUMBER OF FREE SLOTS ON THE START/SASI QUEUE.

fields.name: ASVTANR
fields.description: NUMBER OF FREE SLOTS ON THE NON-REUSABLE REPLACEMENT QUEUE.

fields.name: ASVTNONR
fields.description: ORIGINAL SIZE OF NON-REUSABLE REPLACEMENT QUEUE.

fields.name: ASVTMAXI
fields.description: ORIGINAL MAX USERS COUNT AS INPUT TO IEAVNP09. OWNERSHIP - SUPERVISOR CONTROL SERIALIZATION - NIP RIM PROCESS

fields.name: ASVTMDSC
fields.description: MAXUSER DEFICIT SLOT COUNT. ASVTMDSC = ASVTMAXI - ASVTAAV - NUMBER OF ACTIVE A.S. INCREMENTED WHEN WE TRY TO TAKE A REPLACEMENT SLOT BUT THERE AREN'T ANY. DECREMENTED WHEN NON-ZERO AND A NONREUSEABLE ASID BECOMES REUSEABLE AND WE ADD A SLOT TO THE MAXUSER POOL WHEN AN ADDRESS SPACE BECOMES REUSEABLE.

fields.name: ASVTFRST
fields.description: ADDRESS OF FIRST AVAILABLE ASVT ENTRY

equates.name: ASVTAVAI
equates.description: BIT ONE IF ASID IS AVAILABLE AND ZERO IF ASID IS ASSIGNED

fields.name: ASVTENTY
fields.description: ENTRY FOR EACH POSSIBLE ASID. IF ADDRESS SPACE ASSIGNED, ENTRY CONTAINS ADDRESS OF ASCB. IF NOT ASSIGNED, ENTRY CONTAINS EITHER ADDRESS OF NEXT AVAILABLE ASID OR ZEROS WITH HIGH-ORDER BIT ON IF LAST ENTRY. IF THE ADDRESS SPACE IS MARKED NON-REUSABLE, THE ENTRY CONTAINS THE ADDRESS OF MASTER'S ASVT ENTRY WITH THE HIGH BIT ON.

equates.name: ASVTAVAL
equates.description: BIT ONE IF ASID IS AVAILABLE AND ZERO IF ASID IS ASSIGNED

equates.name: ASVTLEN
equates.description: ASVT -      LENGTH OF ASVT INCLUDING RESERVED FIELDS

equates.name: ASVTULEN
equates.description: ASVTBEGN -  LENGTH OF USED FIELDS IN ASVT
